g.text: ALEC SENSOR S0 — electrical study; no PCB or ingress qualification.

g.desc: ALEC SENSOR S0 — electrical study; no PCB or ingress qualification.

g.text: 3 AA primary cells; no charging. USB-C is data-only: batteries + SW1 ON required.

g.desc: 3 AA primary cells; no charging. USB-C is data-only: batteries + SW1 ON required.

g.text: SW1 is a hard battery disconnect; DC current rating, fuse and package are OPEN design items.

g.desc: SW1 is a hard battery disconnect; DC current rating, fuse and package are OPEN design items.

g.text: RTC time survives ESP deep sleep, but is lost on SW1 OFF or battery removal. Resync before arming.

g.desc: RTC time survives ESP deep sleep, but is lost on SW1 OFF or battery removal. Resync before arming.

g.text: Schematic study only. Switch, protection, connector retention,

g.desc: Schematic study only. Switch, protection, connector retention,

g.text: radome and wet-room behavior must be resolved before PCB release.

g.desc: radome and wet-room behavior must be resolved before PCB release.

g.text: RV-3028: I2C GPIO8 SDA / GPIO9 SCL; interrupt GPIO1 (active LOW).

g.desc: RV-3028: I2C GPIO8 SDA / GPIO9 SCL; interrupt GPIO1 (active LOW).

g.text: Short press GPIO10: battery; long press: physical pairing.

g.desc: Short press GPIO10: battery; long press: physical pairing.

g.text: RGB common anode; GPIO38/39/40 LOW lights R/G/B.

g.desc: RGB common anode; GPIO38/39/40 LOW lights R/G/B.

g.text: No always-on power LED. Use low-duty PWM for presence indication.

g.desc: No always-on power LED. Use low-duty PWM for presence indication.

g.text: 3.31 V always on with SW1 closed. 4.985 V radar rail: GPIO16 high = ON.

g.desc: 3.31 V always on with SW1 closed. 4.985 V radar rail: GPIO16 high = ON.

g.text: R19 holds radar OFF during reset; PS/SYNC high permits power-save operation.

g.desc: R19 holds radar OFF during reset; PS/SYNC high permits power-save operation.

g.text: Reserve >=200 mA at the radar connector; measure startup at depleted-cell voltage.

g.desc: Reserve >=200 mA at the radar connector; measure startup at depleted-cell voltage.

g.text: GPIO17 TX -> radar RX; GPIO18 RX <- radar TX. UART: 256000 8N1.

g.desc: GPIO17 TX -> radar RX; GPIO18 RX <- radar TX. UART: 256000 8N1.

g.text: GPIO4 = presence wake. GPIO11 = I/O switch enable, default OFF.

g.desc: GPIO4 = presence wake. GPIO11 = I/O switch enable, default OFF.

g.text: Power up: I/O OFF -> rail ON -> PG valid -> I/O ON -> fresh valid frames.

g.desc: Power up: I/O OFF -> rail ON -> PG valid -> I/O ON -> fresh valid frames.

g.text: Power down: I/O OFF -> UART stop -> rail OFF. OUT cannot wake if radar is off.

g.desc: Power down: I/O OFF -> UART stop -> rail OFF. OUT cannot wake if radar is off.
